Helpy / Ways neighbors help

Computer and phone help, from a neighbor who gets it

A new phone that needs your photos moved over. A printer that stopped talking to the Wi-Fi. A Zoom link that just won't open. Usually it's half an hour with someone who knows. On Helpy, those people live nearby and offer to help.

Download on theApp StoreGet it onGoogle Play

For example

  • Setting up a new phone and moving photos and contacts
  • A printer or router that won't connect
  • Installing an app or updating a computer
  • Learning Zoom, WhatsApp or Gmail

How it works

  1. Download HelpyIt's free on iPhone and Android. Sign in with Google, or with Apple on iPhone.
  2. Post or browseSay what you need, or scroll to see who nearby is offering help.
  3. Sort it out in chatAgree on where and when, meet up, then rate each other.

Good to know

  • Never share passwords, SMS codes or card details, not even with a nice neighbor.
  • Keep the help in front of you rather than handing over remote control.
  • Back up anything important before anyone fixes anything.

Questions

Can someone help over a video call?

Most help on Helpy happens in person, between people who live close. If you both prefer video, arrange it in the chat.

My computer is properly broken. Is this the place?

For hardware faults or data recovery, go to a technician. Neighbors mostly help with settings, installs and explaining.

Does it cost anything?

No. The app is free, and help between neighbors is never paid.

Who can see where I live?

Posts show a rough area and a distance, never an address. Your exact location is only shared with the neighbor you approve.

Is it safe?

Before you reach out to a neighbor, you verify your phone number. Profiles carry ratings and reviews, and you can report or block anyone in one tap. We don't run background checks, so whether to meet is always your call.
